title: Primitive quotient scalar model normalization
statement: For the scalar realization isomorphism constructed from the coherent quotient extension model, the quotient-generator and normalized Roos comparison equations hold for every simultaneous coefficient reduction presentation.

source.place: Tags 06YY and 0941; balanced scalar association and normalized Roos comparison in the primitive quotient realization construction

proof.text: On each finite quotient, transpose the balanced scalar association through the scalar-extension adjunction and verify its value on 1 tensor x. The maps commute with quotient transitions and cochain differentials, so the strict Roos comparison gives the required generator and derived equations. Descend from simultaneous K-flat representatives to every coherent presentation by naturality.

proof_origin.place: Balanced finite quotient association and normalized Roos comparison, split from primitive scalar model existence.

lean.statement:
theorem primitiveQuotientScalarModelNormalization
    (W : Scheme.{t})
    (_hlW : ∀ x : W, IsUnit (l : W.residueField x))
    (SW : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus l E W)
    (ρW : IntegralComparisonRoosModel l L W)
    (realization : integralScalarExtensionOfUniverses l E L ι W ≅
      SW.reduction ⋙ integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar l E L ι W ⋙
        coefficientSequenceLimit l L W) :
    IsIntegralComparisonScalarNormalized l E L ι W SW ρW realization
